bibliographic.title: Hauntings at St. Comba's Academy
bibliographic.author: W.H. Arthur
bibliographic.description:
Hauntings at St. Comba's Academy is an interactive fiction based on a scenario I am writing for 2D4 & Explore.

This is created for Neo-Twiny Jam 2025, a game jam for interactive fictions under 500 words.

Initially, I tried to code in the rules of 2D4 & Explore, where the story plays out differently depends on the player character's proficiencies and items, as well as implementing dice mechanics to determine the outcome for certain interactions. However, there is no way I can fit all that in 500 words.

I deleted a lot of the code and make use of the words I have to create a tight but hopefully interesting experience for the player.
